name: Silicon Integration
old_description: Integration was founded in 1996, and we offer complete turn-key and consignment
about:
Silicon Integration was founded in 1996 in Milford, Connecticut. The company operates as an electronic contract manufacturer.

The company specializes in printed circuit board assembly, offering high-volume low-cost production, high-mix low-to-medium volume runs, and quick-turn prototypes. Its services extend to turn-key and consignment assembly, new product introduction (NPI), system assembly, testing, fulfillment, hardware and software design, schematic capture, PCB layout, material management, and modifications. The facility handles advanced package placement including ball grid arrays (BGA) and employs degreed engineers. Component sensitivity procedures such as baking and sealing are also performed.

Silicon Integration serves customers in telecommunications, industrial, consumer, medical, trading, academic, and broadcast industries. The company works with original equipment manufacturers and other businesses requiring electronic manufacturing services.

The company emphasizes world-class manufacturing principles, advanced technologies, and state-of-the-art software tools to help customers reduce time-to-market and increase profitability. It highlights its degreed engineering staff, RoHS compliance solutions, and integrated quality system as key differentiators.
type_evidence: Silicon Integration is a leading Electronic Contract Manufacturing company specializing in cost-effective low to high volume Complex Surface Mount and Mixed Technology PCB assembly.
